openai.system: str      (default: None) - system prompt via instructions
openai.stream: bool     (default: False) - returns a generator if True
openai.tools: list     (default: None) - list of function definitions
openai.presence_penalty: float    (default: None) - encourage new topics, -2.0 to 2.0
openai.n: int      (default: None) - number of completions to generate
openai.user: str      (default: None) - end user ID for abuse tracking

anthropic.stream: bool     (default: False) - returns a generator if True
anthropic.tools: list     (default: None) - list of tool definitions
anthropic.stop_sequences: list     (default: None) - list of stop strings

google.stream: bool     (default: False) - returns a generator if True
google.tools: list     (default: None) - list of tool definitions
google.stop_sequences: list     (default: None) - list of stop strings
google.candidate_count: int      (default: None) - number of responses to generate
